svg.title: Dragon Database — Codex Folio Desktop Concept
svg.desc: A restrained literary archive design on a matte-silver field. The original transparent Swordslapper Classic logo remains small in the header, regular Grenze title-case headings establish an editorial hierarchy, and a moderate unchanged dragon mark appears on a quiet rectangular silver panel. Three text-led dragon form cards use small muted original silhouettes. Fine rules, ample margins, a single primary browsing action, and quiet Collections, Lore, and account access complete the composition.
svg.metadata: Landing page hero design concept. Illustrative archive copy and dragon type cards. Selected v8 Swordslapper Classic underline logo foreground reused unchanged. Restrained editorial typography; Alegreya Sans is licensed in logos/v7/fonts, and optional Grenze Regular in logos/v6/fonts. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not an implemented application.

g.title: Dragon Database — Swordslapper Classic
g.desc: The selected Swordmaw Hybrid dragon, wings, DB monogram and crossed swords with a new DragonSlapper Dragon Database wordmark. Both words align to the full width of the original horizontal sword beneath the lettering. Black on silver.
g.metadata: Logo concept. Original v7 Swordmaw Hybrid dragon and crossed swords reused with unchanged artwork. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Source lettering and its graphic adaptations retain CC BY-SA 3.0 licensing. Application code and adopted brand assets have not been changed.
